tools.name: sign_up
tools.description: Start a ShipMyForm account from an email address, with no browser. A 6-digit code is emailed to the address; verify_account with { email, code } then returns the API key. Works without authentication. Also works for an existing account (the code approves API access).

tools.name: verify_account
tools.description: Prove the address with the 6-digit code emailed by sign_up. Without a key on the connection, pass the email too: on success this returns the API key (shown once). Turns on email notifications.

tools.name: resend_verification_code
tools.description: Email a fresh 6-digit verification code to the account's address.

tools.name: get_account
tools.description: The account's email, verification state, plan, limits, usage and dashboard URL.

tools.name: create_api_key
tools.description: Mint another API key for this workspace (shown once), optionally narrower than this one. A key can never grant scopes it does not itself hold, so this is the safe way to hand a limited key to another agent.

tools.name: list_api_keys
tools.description: API keys on this workspace (metadata only).

tools.name: revoke_api_key
tools.description: Revoke a key by id. The key in use on this connection cannot revoke itself.

tools.name: start_upgrade
tools.description: Get a hosted checkout URL for the Starter or Business plan. Payment is completed by a person on that page; the plan activates automatically afterwards (check with get_account).

tools.name: get_billing_portal
tools.description: A self-service billing portal URL: change plan, update the card, cancel.

tools.name: list_forms
tools.description: The workspace's forms with their public endpoint URLs.

tools.name: create_form
tools.description: Create a form and get its endpoint plus a paste-ready HTML snippet. Email notifications to the account owner are set up automatically. Works on every plan.

tools.name: get_form
tools.description: A form's full configuration, connectors and hosted-page status.

tools.name: update_form
tools.description: Change any subset of a form's settings: name, purpose, allowedDomains, redirectUrl, spamMode, active, storeSubmissions, validation rules, blocklist, autoResponder (Pro).

tools.name: delete_form
tools.description: Delete a form; its endpoint stops accepting submissions.

tools.name: get_form_snippet
tools.description: A copy-paste form snippet for a framework (html, react, vue, or fetch) wired to the form's endpoint.

tools.name: get_submission_stats
tools.description: Delivered / spam-held / flagged counts for a form, plus workspace quota usage. Works on every plan.

tools.name: list_connector_types
tools.description: Every destination submissions can be routed to, with the config fields each needs and which plan it requires.

tools.name: list_connectors
tools.description: Connectors on a form with their status and last error.

tools.name: add_connector
tools.description: Route a form's submissions somewhere: email, webhook, Slack, Discord, Airtable, HubSpot, Telegram and more. Get the config fields from list_connector_types. OAuth connectors (Google Sheets, Notion) must be added in the dashboard.

tools.name: test_connector
tools.description: Send a test delivery through a connector and report the result.

tools.name: publish_hosted_page
tools.description: Publish a standalone page for the form on shipmyform.com (no website needed) and get its URL plus an embed script. Uses the designed page if one exists, otherwise a default email + message form.

tools.name: list_submissions
tools.description: Read submissions across the workspace or for one form, with filters (status, date range, text search, country, attachments, failed deliveries) and paging. Spam is excluded unless status is 'spam'. Requires a paid plan.

tools.name: get_submission
tools.description: One submission with spam signals and delivery history.

tools.name: label_submissions
tools.description: Mark submissions as spam, ok (not spam) or flagged. spam/ok also teach the classifier, so your judgement improves future filtering. This is how you triage in your own environment: list, decide, label.

tools.name: delete_submissions
tools.description: Permanently delete submissions (and their files).

tools.name: export_submissions
tools.description: All of a form's submissions (up to 2,000) as CSV text, optionally filtered by status.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_account, start_upgrade, get_billing_portal, list_forms, create_form, get_form_snippet, add_connector, publish_hosted_page · Private data: sign_up, verify_account, create_api_key, list_api_keys, revoke_api_key, delete_submissions · Public sink: sign_up, verify_account, resend_verification_code, get_account, create_form, add_connector, test_connector, publish_hosted_page · Destructive: delete_form, remove_connector, delete_submissions.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_account, start_upgrade, get_billing_portal, list_forms, create_form, get_form_snippet, add_connector, publish_hosted_page · Private data: sign_up, verify_account, create_api_key, list_api_keys, revoke_api_key, delete_submissions · Public sink: sign_up, verify_account, resend_verification_code, get_account, create_form, add_connector, test_connector, publish_hosted_page · Destructive: delete_form, remove_connector, delete_submissions

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
